lines.en: The blackened soil hums beneath my hooves.

lines.zh: 我踏过的地方不留活物。
lines.en: Nothing living remains where I tread.

lines.zh: 这片荒原只认得我的蹄印。
lines.en: This wasteland knows only my hoofprints.
The shadows travel at my side.

lines.zh: 每一步都碾碎脆弱的魂火。
lines.en: Each step crushes fragile soulfire.
I patrol the world of black gold.
My horn slices the heavy air.

lines.zh: 远处有气息，我循之而去。
lines.en: A presence stirs afar; I follow it.
My hooves fall low, like a muffled knell.
I trample the silence of the wastes.
Do not block my path, living thing.
Darkness flows beside me.

lines.zh: 黑金之风掠过我的鬃毛。
lines.en: The black-gold wind brushes my mane.
I pause here, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 荒原太安静了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The wastes are too quiet. I dislike it.
My horn grows faintly warm.
Soulfire flickers in the distance.

lines.zh: 我不需要休息，只是暂歇。
lines.en: I need no rest; I merely pause.

lines.zh: 这片土地记得我的存在。
lines.en: This land remembers my presence.
Let the darkness thicken further.

lines.zh: 静立时，我听见地底的低语。
lines.en: Standing still, I hear whispers underground.
No prey passes. How dull.
The life in you is glaring.

lines.zh: 又一个闯入黑金世界的活物。
lines.en: Another living thing trespasses the black-gold world.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声，我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat clearly.
On the black gold sand I get a clear look at you.

lines.zh: 你带着灵魂的气味而来。
lines.en: You come bearing the scent of a soul.
These wastes do not welcome you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在发抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes tremble. I see it.

lines.zh: 靠近一步，我就让你留下。
lines.en: One step closer, and you stay forever.
Living one, why have you come?
I have memorized your shape.
This scratch is not worth a glance.

lines.zh: 你竟敢碰我的黑金之躯。
lines.en: You dared touch my black-gold body.
Pain only makes me faster.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛沾了血，是你的。
lines.en: My mane is bloodied. It is yours.

lines.zh: 我的四蹄钉在荒原的沙里。
lines.en: My four hooves stay planted in the wasteland sand.

lines.zh: 你惹怒了荒原的巡行者。
lines.en: You have angered the wastes' patroller.

lines.zh: 黑金之躯上，多了一道白痕。
lines.en: A white mark is left on my black-gold hide.
Do not mistake bleeding for weakness.
Your strike is too light.
The wastes will collect for me.
Food? I do not eat such things.

lines.zh: 把那东西拿开，我只要灵魂。
lines.en: Put that away. I want only souls.

lines.zh: 你以为我会为一口吃食低头？
lines.en: You think I would bow for a morsel?

lines.zh: 黑金独角兽不靠进食活着。
lines.en: A Mortum Cadillion does not live by feeding.
Luring me with food is an insult.

lines.zh: 我闻到的只有你的恐惧。
lines.en: All I smell is your fear.

lines.zh: 别晃了，那对我不算什么。
lines.en: Stop waving it. It means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我追逐的是猎物，不是饲料。
lines.en: I chase prey, not fodder.
I trample your kindness underfoot.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，否则我先吃你。
lines.en: Put it away, or I will take you first.
Running into me was your mistake.
Your bones are far too soft.
Move. Do not cling to my hooves.
That one was your own doing.
You would stop me with your body?
Back away, living thing.

lines.zh: 独角碰着你了吗？真可惜。
lines.en: Did my horn touch you? A pity.

lines.zh: 黑金荒原上，碰撞即开战。
lines.en: In the black-gold wastes, contact means war.

lines.zh: 你的重量对我毫无意义。
lines.en: Your weight means nothing to me.
Collide again, and I answer in kind.

lines.zh: 同类之间才有这种念头。
lines.en: Such thoughts belong to my own kind.
In these wastes, I seek only my own kind.

lines.zh: 你连独角都没有，谈什么。
lines.en: You lack even a horn. What is there to speak of?
Away. I do not pair with you.
My kind are not here.

lines.zh: 别靠近，这是同族之间的事。
lines.en: Stay back. This is a matter for my own kind.

lines.zh: 你身上的生气让我厌恶。
lines.en: The life in you repels me.

lines.zh: 我不会为活物停下巡行。
lines.en: I will not halt my patrol for a living thing.

lines.zh: 找你的同类去，别来找我。
lines.en: Seek your own kind. Do not come to me.
Such matters are no business of intruders.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只踏碎它们。
lines.en: I pick nothing up. I only crush things underfoot.
Things on the ground are no concern of mine.

lines.zh: 我的角尖挑开挡路的枯骨。
lines.en: My horn tip flicks aside the bones in my path.

lines.zh: 黑金之魂不需要我去拾取。
lines.en: Souls of black gold need no picking up by me.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子不会为你停留。
lines.en: My hooves will not pause for you.

lines.zh: 这些东西不值得我低头。
lines.en: These things are not worth lowering my head.
Pick it up if you must, but do not block me.

lines.zh: 荒原上的遗落，自有其去处。
lines.en: What falls in the wastes has its own fate.
I do not collect. I patrol.
Lower my head? That is for the weak.

lines.zh: 独角压低，黑金之土先裂开。
lines.en: Horn lowered, the black soil cracks first.

lines.zh: 终于有东西值得我动了。
lines.en: At last, something worth moving for.
Your life force is locked in.
Do not run. That only makes it worse.
I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 你的气息扰乱了荒原的寂静。
lines.en: Your presence disrupts the silence of the wastes.
I am coming, living thing.
My horn rises for you.
You walked into this yourself.
I smell a trembling soul.
You have been seen.

lines.zh: 荒原要一个祭品，就你吧。
lines.en: The wastes want an offering. You will do.
Do not look back. I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 你逃不出我的巡行范围。
lines.en: You cannot leave my patrol range.

lines.zh: 盯上你，是这片土地的意思。
lines.en: Fixing on you is this land's will.
Stand up. Do not disappoint me.
How much farther can you run?
My hoofbeats are closing in.

lines.zh: 别躲了，荒原没有藏身处。
lines.en: Do not hide. The wastes offer no cover.

lines.zh: 黑金之魂在我角上烧着。
lines.en: Black-gold souls burn on my horn.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，蹄印围成一圈。
lines.en: I circle you, hoofprints forming a ring.
One more step back, and it is over.
The life in you is fading.
I am patient, prey.

lines.zh: 荒原的风把你的气味送来了。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent to me.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的沙，替你数着步。
lines.en: The Augite sand counts your steps.
You glanced back. Good.
The darkness will close in for me.
You cannot stop my horn.
Run. I enjoy watching.

lines.zh: 我的巡行没有终点，你有。
lines.en: My patrol has no end. Yours does.
Your heart beats faster and faster.

lines.zh: 这片荒原会记住你的结局。
lines.en: These wastes will remember your end.
Do not expect rescue.
The wastes have already surrounded you.
The last stretch, living thing.

lines.zh: 独角贯穿，别怪我不客气。
lines.en: My horn pierces through. Do not blame me.
Remember this blow for the rest of your life.
Your flesh cannot stop black gold.
Fall, living thing.
Hoof and horn come down together.
Does it hurt? Good.
Your guard shatters beneath my hooves.
Closer still, and I send you on your way.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，我本身就是。
lines.en: I need no weapon. I am one.

lines.zh: 这一击带着荒原的意志。
lines.en: This strike carries the will of the wastes.
Dodged? Next time you will not.

lines.zh: 让独角告诉你什么叫终局。
lines.en: Let my horn show you the end.

lines.zh: 我的独角从你盾牌上方压下去。
lines.en: My horn comes down over the top of your shield.
Do not retreat. There is no time left for it.
This blow is the wastes' tax.
I step down, and you are gone.
Blood makes the black gold brighter.

lines.zh: 你挡得了一次，挡不了十次。
lines.en: You block one, not ten.
Beneath my horn there is no luck.
It is over, living thing.

lines.zh: 黑金世界又多了一道蹄声。
lines.en: The black-gold world gains another set of hoofbeats.

lines.zh: 我从荒原的阴影里踏出。
lines.en: I step out of the wastes' shadow.
The horn arrives first; the body follows.
This land has called me awake.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着黑金的气息。
lines.en: I am here, bearing the scent of black gold.

lines.zh: 荒原需要巡行者，我便出现。
lines.en: The wastes need a patrol; so I appear.
The ground trembles beneath my hooves.
Living things, lift your heads.
Darkness parts a road for me.
I take shape from black gold.
A new patrol begins.
Do not ask where I came from. Ask the wastes.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过我的皮，我不退。
lines.en: Flame licks my hide; I do not retreat.
Falling from a height, my hooves stay steady.
Water would drown me? Black gold does not sink.
The blast shoves me; I dig in deeper.

lines.zh: 飞来的东西，只配擦过我的角。
lines.en: Flying things are fit only to graze my horn.

lines.zh: 法术在我身上烧出火花，无用。
lines.en: Spells spark against me. Useless.

lines.zh: 饥饿与我无关，我只渴求巡行。
lines.en: Hunger is not mine. I thirst only to patrol.

lines.zh: 雷击落下，我的独角更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning falls; my horn shines brighter.

lines.zh: 虚空拉扯我，但荒原抓住我。
lines.en: The void pulls at me, but the wastes hold me.
